OFFLINE.description: The device is not online, or no information is available. The device is offline if no ARs other than possible Device Access AR’s exist.

OFFLINE_DOCKING.description: The device is a docking device and currently not online.

ONLINE.description: The device is online. This is the case if at least one AR other than possible Device Access AR’s exists.

ONLINE_DOCKING.description: The device is a docking device and currently online.
